services.value: NRC Labs provides environmental analytical testing services, specializing in Drinking Water, Wastewater, Hazardous Wastes, and Asbestos. Services described include accredited/residential and public drinking water analysis, biosolids testing, wastewater services, stormwater analysis, irrigation water analysis, RCRA hazardous waste analysis, and Legionella testing (CDC ELITE & ORELAP accredited).
